svg.title: Held-out successful-error distributions and failures
svg.desc: Boxplots pool successful absolute errors across 864 held-out stacks with 10th-90th percentile whiskers; diamonds show observed medians with 2,000 paired field-bootstrap 95% intervals, and the separate panel counts unresolved estimates over all 864 stacks.
